main.remarks: An immutable lightweight summary of token-specific assertion facts intended for runtime policy evaluation.

property.name: AuthenticationContextClassReference
property.summary: OIDC authentication context class reference (`acr`) if present.

property.name: AuthenticationMethods
property.summary: Normalized authentication methods carried by the token assertion summary.

property.name: AuthenticationTime
property.summary: Authentication instant if the token summary provides one; otherwise null.

property.name: Audiences
property.summary: Normalized audiences carried by the token assertion summary.

property.name: IssuedAt
property.summary: Assertion issuance instant if present; otherwise null.

property.name: NotAfter
property.summary: Assertion expiration instant if present; otherwise null.

property.name: NotBefore
property.summary: Assertion not-before instant if present; otherwise null.

property.name: Scopes
property.summary: Normalized scopes carried by the token assertion summary.

method.name: Copy
method.summary: Create a copy of the token assertion summary.

method.name: HasAudience
method.summary: Determine whether the token assertion summary contains a normalized audience.
method.returns: True if the audience is present; otherwise false.

method.name: HasAuthenticationMethod
method.summary: Determine whether the token assertion summary contains a normalized authentication method.
method.returns: True if the authentication method is present; otherwise false.

method.name: HasScope
method.summary: Determine whether the token assertion summary contains a normalized scope.
method.returns: True if the scope is present; otherwise false.

method.name: IsExpiredAt
method.summary: Determine whether the token assertion summary would be expired at a specific instant.
method.param: Instant to test against the assertion expiration time.
method.returns: True if the assertion has an expiration time and that time is before the supplied instant; otherwise false.
